title: Describe an Interrupted Task

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Write your own first draft; the fictional example is for study, not your submission.
prompt: Write 120–160 words about a fictional workplace or community task that was interrupted by a small problem. Explain what people were doing, what happened, how they responded, and what they learned. Use at least six lesson words and two past continuous sentences.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Use four parts: place and activity; the problem; the safe response; a lesson or follow-up. Use when for the shorter event and while for a longer background action when suitable.

reference: At a community workshop, two people were moving a heavy table when they noticed water near the door. The floor was slippery, so they stopped instead of crossing it. One person gave a signal, and the supervisor was checking the area while the others were moving away. They placed a barrier around the spill and kept the exit clear. The supervisor explained that the risk was a fall, even though no one had been hurt. After the water was cleaned, the group inspected the floor together. Then they moved the table along a different path. They wrote a short note to remind the next team not to leave drinks near the work area. The event showed that careful communication can help prevent an accident without blaming anyone.
